compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.title: ASC CEO
compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.description: Compass Surgical Partners is a leading, independent, full-service ambulatory surgery center (ASC) development and management partner. An exclusive partner for premier health systems, Compass has built a nationwide portfolio of ASC joint ventures with health systems and physicians. Compass’ experienced leadership team has developed more than 250 ASCs over the past three decades, making it the partner of choice for high-performance ASCs. Differentiated by a proven track record of success and an agile, aligned operating model, Compass Surgical Partners aims to create strong partnerships that improve the lives of patients and providers. Learn more at www.compass-sp.com http://www.compass-sp.com. ROLE OVERVIEW Compass Surgical Partners is seeking an accomplished healthcare executive to lead one of our ambulatory surgery centers as Chief Executive Officer. This is more than a traditional surgery center administrator role. As the senior business leader for the center, you'll be responsible for driving financial performance, strengthening physician partnerships, leading operational and clinical excellence, and developing a high-performing leadership team. Working closely with physician owners, health system partners, governing boards, and Compass leadership, you'll shape the long-term strategy of the center while creating exceptional outcomes for patients, physicians, team members, and our organization. Lead the Business. Build Partnerships. Drive Growth. Location: St. Francis Ambulatory Surgery Center Address: 13701 Bon Secours Drive, Suite 100, Midlothian, VA 23114 St. Francis Ambulatory Surgery Center is an ASC located in Midlothian, VA. With two operating rooms and one procedure room, the center will provide high-quality, cost-effective outpatient surgical care across multiple specialties. Owned and operated in partnership with BSMH and Compass Surgical Partners (an ASC management organization), the center will combine advanced technology with compassionate, patient-centered care in a convenient outpatient setting. cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:0d9.title: Shop Foreman
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:0d9.description: For over 50 years, Cabinetry Unlimited has been the leading expert in Custom Cabinetry and Counter Tops throughout the Delmarva region. With over 1,000 projects completed yearly, we know that customizing a kitchen and bathroom is no simple task! Cabinetry Unlimited is seeking an experienced full-time Shop Foreman to oversee our laminate cabinetry and solid surface countertops fabrication operations. As a vital member of our team, the Shop Manager will be responsible for managing all aspects of the shop, ensuring efficient production, maintaining quality standards, and fostering a safe and productive work environment. Don’t miss this opportunity to grow with us.
responsibilities: Oversee day-to-day operations of the cabinetry and solid surface countertops production shop.
Manage production schedules to meet deadlines and customer demands.
Supervise and motivate a team of craftsmen, ensuring productivity and quality standards are met.
Train new employees on production techniques, safety procedures, and equipment operation.
Maintain inventory levels of materials and supplies, and coordinate orders as needed by reviewing architectural plans.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and procedures and implement measures to prevent accidents and injuries.
Troubleshoot production issues and implement solutions to optimize efficiency.
Collaborate with other departments, such as design and sales, to ensure seamless workflow and customer satisfaction.
Conduct regular inspections of equipment and tools, and schedule maintenance and repairs as necessary.
Keep accurate records of production output, employee hours, and material usage.

Please note this list includes key duties and responsibilities but is not intended to be comprehensive. Additional duties, responsibilities and activities may be necessary for success in the position.
qualifications: Proven experience in cabinetry and solid surface countertops production, with at least 3 years of experience in a managerial role.
Extensive knowledge of woodworking techniques, materials, and equipment.
CNC programing experience is a plus.
Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to motivate and mentor a team.
Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Knowledge of safety regulations and procedures related to woodworking and manufacturing environments.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other relevant software applications.
Flexibility to work evenings or weekends as needed based on client deadlines.
Certification in woodworking or related field is a plus.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:6bb.description: At Backcountry, our mission is to connect people to their passions. Our four online stores—Backcountry, Competitive Cyclist, MotoSport and, SteepandCheap—aim to supply our customers with the gear, knowledge, and inspiration necessary to get out there and chase down life’s greatest moments. We do this by providing the biggest and best assortment of premium outdoor products, superior shopping experience, personalized Gearhead expertise, lightning-fast and accurate fulfillment, and inspirational, informative, and community-centered content. Backcountry needs an experienced mechanic with a strong attention to detail to join our Distribution Center Bike Shop in Salt Lake City. What sets us apart from other retailers? We're online 24/7 and only offer a premium, curated assortment of product within the bike industry. This job requires experience in high-end bicycle mechanics, attention to detail and the ability to problem solve. This is a great opportunity for an experienced, quality, mechanic.

Disc brake set up

Suspension
Proper frame prep techniques (facing and tapping)
Wheel truing
Understanding of bicycle fit
Attention to detail and ability to problem solve issues
Proficiency with computer programs
General computer, email, word processing, and internet skills

jobgether-jobgether:lever:3da0181d-5206-.title: Content and Social Media Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:3da0181d-5206-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Content and Social Media Manager based in Spain. As a Content and Social Media Manager, you’ll own the editorial engine across multiple channels, creating content that strengthens brand visibility and generates qualified business opportunities. You’ll combine strong writing skills with strategic thinking to produce authoritative content for blogs, websites, sales materials, press communications, and email campaigns. A major part of the role will involve building a compelling LinkedIn presence through distinctive narratives, relevant insights, and experimentation with new formats. You’ll work closely with subject matter experts, marketers, product teams, and senior leaders to turn complex ideas into clear, credible, engaging stories. The role offers significant creative ownership, from planning the editorial calendar through writing, publishing, performance analysis, and optimization. You’ll join a fast-moving international environment where initiative, curiosity, and a willingness to experiment are highly valued. This is an ideal opportunity for a hands-on content professional who wants to shape a growing B2B technology brand through exceptional writing and social storytelling. Own and manage the editorial calendar across blogs, LinkedIn, email campaigns, website content, and sales materials, ensuring content is planned, produced, and published on schedule. Write and edit long-form content, including blog articles, bylined pieces, data-driven reports, one-pagers, and website copy. Transform input from internal experts into authoritative, accessible content that delivers meaningful value to a professional B2B audience. Lead day-to-day social media execution across LinkedIn and emerging channels, developing compelling content and testing new formats and narratives. Develop and manage press releases related to product launches, partnerships, licensing milestones, company announcements, and other significant developments. Coordinate press distribution with relevant trade publications, media outlets, and external PR partners. Adapt existing and newly produced video content for social media in collaboration with marketing and creative stakeholders. Monitor content and social media performance, identify successful formats and topics, and adjust the editorial strategy based on results. Collaborate with marketing leadership, subject matter experts, traders, product managers, and executives to develop credible and engaging stories. Continuously explore new content approaches, formats, tools, and workflows to strengthen the effectiveness of the editorial operation. Requirements 4+ years of professional experience in content marketing, editorial, communications , or a closely related field, ideally within B2B technology. A portfolio demonstrating strong long-form and short-form content that you have personally written, developed, and published. Proven experience using LinkedIn as a B2B content and marketing channel , with a strong understanding of what drives engagement and business impact. Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to develop compelling narratives and adapt tone and format to different audiences and channels. Demonstrated ability to translate complex or technical input from subject matter experts into clear, credible, and engaging content. Strong editorial judgment and a willingness to experiment with emerging content formats and storytelling approaches. Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and take ownership in a fast-moving environment without requiring a detailed playbook. Strong analytical mindset and ability to use content and social performance data to inform future decisions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:4862416a-7406-.title: Performance Marketing Motion Designer / Video Editor
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4862416a-7406-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Performance Marketing Motion Designer / Video Editor based in Italy. This role is designed for a creative professional who combines strong visual storytelling with a genuine interest in performance marketing and data. You will create, edit, and animate paid social creatives designed not only to look compelling, but also to generate measurable business results. Working closely with creative and marketing teams, you will develop concepts, test variations, analyze performance, and continuously improve advertising assets. The position offers exposure to multiple digital platforms, including Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, as well as a wide range of creative formats. You will use performance metrics to understand why certain creative decisions succeed and translate those insights into stronger future campaigns. The role also encourages the use of AI-powered creative tools to accelerate ideation, production, and experimentation without compromising quality. It is an opportunity to combine motion design, video editing, visual communication, and data-driven creative strategy in a fast-paced environment. Conceptualize, design, edit, and animate static and video assets for performance-focused social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other digital platforms. Translate marketing objectives, audience insights, and campaign goals into engaging creative concepts designed to drive measurable actions. Break down successful advertisements into key components such as hooks, problems, solutions, proof points, offers, and calls to action, then develop modular variations for structured A/B testing. Review creative performance data and use metrics such as CTR, CPA, ROAS, CVR, CPM, CPC, VTR, thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and watch time to identify performance patterns. Analyze individual creative assets to determine which visual, messaging, storytelling, and editing choices contribute to stronger results. Turn campaign data and stakeholder feedback into actionable creative iterations rather than relying solely on personal design preferences. Manage complete post-production workflows, including video editing, sound design, VFX, motion graphics, dynamic typography, color correction, and creative adaptation. Adapt successful creatives into multiple versions, placements, aspect ratios, and formats while maintaining clear organization, naming conventions, and version control. Research competitor advertising, platform trends, audience behavior, and high-performing creative formats to identify new concepts and testing opportunities. Manage assigned creative projects from initial brief through final delivery while communicating effectively with creative, marketing, and account teams. Use AI-powered tools for image generation, video production, copy development, ideation, experimentation, and workflow optimization. Apply strong principles of composition, color, typography, hierarchy, pacing, and visual storytelling to create content that communicates clearly and converts effectively. Manage multiple creative projects, deadlines, and variations while maintaining a high standard of quality and attention to detail. Requirements 3–5 years of professional experience in motion design, video editing, performance creative, or a closely related field. Strong portfolio demonstrating motion design, video editing, paid social creative, and social-first storytelling. Proven experience creating performance-oriented advertisements for platforms such as Meta, TikTok, and YouTube. Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics, including CTR, CPA, ROAS, CVR, CPM, CPC, and video engagement metrics such as watch time. Demonstrated ability to analyze creative performance and turn data-driven insights into specific, actionable recommendations. jobgether-jobgether:lever:93e1c3a7-5ab8-.title: Director of Marketing
jobgether-jobgether:lever:93e1c3a7-5ab8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Marketing based in France. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led business.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:948f8459-c9e6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Project Manager in Marketing Technologies (m/w/d) based in Romania. This is a senior-level opportunity to lead complex digital and Marketing Technology projects from initial planning through implementation, launch, and optimization. You’ll act as the central link between customers, technical specialists, and business stakeholders, turning ambitious goals into structured delivery plans. The role combines strategic project leadership with enough technical depth to navigate AI, data, digital platforms, integrations, and implementation constraints. You’ll coordinate multidisciplinary teams spanning Engineering, AI, Data, UX, Analytics, and Marketing to deliver measurable business outcomes. Strong ownership, proactive risk management, budget control, and clear stakeholder communication will be central to your success. You’ll operate in a dynamic, fast-moving environment where ambiguity is common and the ability to create structure and momentum is highly valued. It’s an ideal role for an experienced project leader who enjoys customer-facing work, complex technology, and driving impactful digital transformation. Take end-to-end ownership of complex Marketing Technology and digital projects, from solution definition and planning through implementation, launch, and continuous optimization. Translate customer needs and business objectives into clearly defined project scopes, delivery plans, milestones, work packages, and actionable tasks in collaboration with technical leads. Build and manage project roadmaps, backlogs, priorities, dependencies, and delivery timelines in close alignment with customers and internal teams. Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across software development, AI, data, UX, analytics, and marketing to ensure effective collaboration and high-quality delivery. Proactively manage schedules, resources, dependencies, risks, issues, and blockers to maintain transparent and predictable project execution. Drive project-level decisions throughout the delivery lifecycle, balancing customer expectations, technical feasibility, resources, timelines, budgets, and business objectives. Own project budget planning, monitoring, and financial transparency while continuously aligning scope, effort, and project progress. Engage in technical discussions with sufficient depth to understand architecture considerations, implementation constraints, data dependencies, integration requirements, and delivery risks. Translate complex technical concepts into clear, structured, and business-relevant communication for customers, business stakeholders, and internal teams. Build strong, trusted relationships with customers through proactive communication, transparent project management, and consistent alignment. Prepare and facilitate customer meetings, project updates, workshops, steering committees, and decision-making sessions. Identify risks, blockers, scope changes, and opportunities for improvement early, and proactively recommend practical solutions. Advise customers on priorities and informed decision-making while clearly communicating the implications of scope, budget, timelines, and technical complexity. Demonstrated experience delivering AI-enabled, data-driven, or otherwise technically complex digital products or IT solutions. Strong technical understanding and the ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers, AI specialists, and data professionals. Sufficient technical expertise to contribute meaningfully to architecture, implementation, integration, and solution-related discussions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c46adc84-267d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in South Africa. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions.
